domain_review: wordBit is equivalent to Nat.testBit under the explicit i<64 hypothesis; no unrestricted wordBit equivalence is claimed.
UInt64.shiftRight masks the converted count modulo 64. cachedBit selects wordBit only with i<64 or 64<=i<128 and i-64<64.
Canonical cache casts reduce modulo 2^64; Nat.testBit_mod_two_pow preserves every selected low or high bit. The high branch uses (word>>>64).testBit(i-64)=word.testBit i.
For i>=128 the original unrestricted Nat.testBit is used, including arbitrary large Nat indices and words.
syndrome retains the exact same List.range/fold order and Nat subtraction. width=0, widths crossing 64/128 and arbitrary over-wide words are covered by the universal theorem.
cachedBit_eq is quantified over every Nat word/index without an acceptance, representability or decoder-dependent precondition.
Machine caches are computed afresh within each syndrome invocation, never across messages or corpus entries.
